Root domain phase tasks / collective drain retained

One word per allocated msection, no fixed VM array. If N sections are allocated, storage is N times sizeof WORD; compared with the former array, metadata delta is (N-64) times sizeof WORD. One acquire/release per attempted winner plus header revalidation. Native ordered-word backend loads each inspected header directly; legacy fallback takes an additional gate around its ordinary read to avoid RMW on read-only storage. Same-section requests and reservation critical sections serialize; payload copy remains parallel. Source metadata trailer stays unchanged. Heap/profile limits unchanged; metadata is charged separately, no measured throughput claim
